description: A central political priority. As SVP president he fronted the party's 'No 10-million Switzerland' (sustainability) initiative seeking to cap the resident population, citing concerns over loss of farmland, housing shortages, crowded transport and schools.
Opposes closer institutional ties with the EU and the free movement of persons; the 10-million initiative envisaged ending the free-movement agreement if thresholds were exceeded.

A farmer by profession, he is active in numerous agricultural and livestock organisations (Schwyz farmers' association, Central Switzerland farmers' union, calf-fatteners, cattle producers, dairy cooperative) and represents agricultural interests in parliament.
Member of the National Council Committee for the Environment, Spatial Planning and Energy (UREK-N). The SVP under his leadership opposed the electricity 'Mantelerlass' (framework act).
Frequently frames politics as a contest between rural regions and cities, arguing that cities 'overrun' rural Switzerland in opinion formation.
